mutations.name: the Cascade interception point goes dead — the classifier is never fed, so leading think-tagged content streams straight to the client exactly as it did before the fix. This is #250 itself re-introduced on the path that carries the traffic

the switch inverts: the reroute is skipped by default and only active when explicitly set to '0'. A default-on kill switch that reads backwards is the shape that ships a fix protecting nobody, and it also breaks the OFF-path assertion — pins both directions of the gate rather than just 'a gate exists'

the classifier is never flushed at the stream tail, so an unterminated span is silently swallowed instead of delivered as text. flush() is the caller-side invariant of ThinkTextClassifier and forgetting it loses content, which is exactly what the reroute must never do

MAX_LEAD overflow is checked BEFORE the marker scan again (the pre-hardening ordering in response-classifier.js): once enough undecided bytes are held, a leading think block is dumped to the text channel unscanned. The reroute silently stops working on whole-body or whitespace-heavy deltas — the leak it exists to break

the accThinking release on the failure path is dropped — a closed rerouted span buffered for emulateTools is silently lost when the stream errors, and an all-thinking turn closes with a raw error frame and no stop
